title: Meet the True One before you brace
summary: Let mercy steady the breath before fear writes the day. Do not let the day outrun this: let this stay with you: let ego and scheming fall so fear can leave with them.
takeaway: Return the breath before fear chooses the story.
lifeApplication: Before the next defensive move, bring the breath back under one line of refuge and mercy.

source.shortMeaning: Meeting the True One loosens fear and subdues ego.
source.lifeApplication: When outcomes tighten you, turn to the True One before you strategize.
